name: Fresh Chicken Breast Tenderloins (Poached in Broth)
whyItWorks: The pectoralis minor "tenderloin" is naturally the most tender, delicate cut of poultry, lacking tough stringy tendons. Simmering gently in chicken bone broth keeps the meat moist and fork-tender with under 1g fat and zero fiber.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Place tenderloins in a saucepan, cover with chicken broth and a pinch of salt, bring to a gentle simmer for 8–10 minutes until cooked through (165°F). Shred with a fork.
